name: an act creates a governing record before its tree and overlay
repeated scopes project a create into a later update
a later malformed segment rolls back earlier entries and local rows
a later cap refusal rolls back every earlier segment
one held segment holds the whole act and one Undo removes it
explicit predictions project into later segment validation
a later oversized intent leaves no notice or earlier local row
no-op segments have no stamp and consume no local ordinal
empty and unchanged acts leave the clock and identity sequence alone
